purpose: Define explicit cancellation, timeout and optional preemption semantics for DWH executions so interrupted work cannot masquerade as successful completion or leave ambiguous accepted writes.

value.request_rule: Cancellation targets an exact execution identity.
value.authorization_rule: Cancellation/preemption requires explicit lifecycle authority where governed.
value.read_rule: Cancelled read/query results are incomplete unless the operation profile explicitly accepts partial output.
value.write_rule: Interrupted mutations obey transaction/atomicity semantics and cannot leave ambiguous accepted state.
value.preemption_rule: Preempted work retains exact resume/restart policy and evidence if resumable.
value.timeout_rule: Timeout is explicit failure/termination evidence and never success.
value.cleanup_rule: Cancellation releases bounded runtime resources/subscriptions/locks according to lifecycle contracts.
